articles.title: Warning: Two Unpatched Citrix NetScaler RCE Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation
articles.summary: Two new unpatched zero-day vulnerabilities in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway appliances that allow remote code execution are being actively exploited in the wild, security firm watchTowr said on September 26.   Citrix has not confirmed the flaws or published a fix. Some administrators say they have taken appliances offline rather than wait for one to be available.   NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway sit at the edge of enterprise networks, where they handle VPN and remote access, load balancing, and user authentication.   The new flaws are not the authentication bypass,  CVE-2026-19490 , that Citrix  fixed on August 19  and that CISA  added  to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog on September 9.   watchTowr described the new flaws as unpatched, and a fix for the bypass has existed since August 19. articles.title_fr: Alerte : Deux failles zero-day RCE non corrigées dans Citrix NetScaler sont activement exploitées
articles.summary_fr: Deux nouvelles vulnérabilités zero-day non corrigées permettant l'exécution de code à distance (RCE) dans les appliances Citrix NetScaler ADC et NetScaler Gateway sont activement exploitées, a rapporté watchTowr le 26 septembre. Citrix n'a pas encore confirmé ces failles ni publié de correctif, poussant certains administrateurs à déconnecter leurs appareils. Ces nouvelles failles sont distinctes de la vulnérabilité de contournement d'authentification CVE-2026-19490, corrigée par Citrix en août.

articles.title: Lunex Stealer Abuses AMD Driver to Disable Security Monitoring and Steal Browser Credentials
articles.summary: The Psychedelic Stealer  malware distributed via compromised Ukrainian websites using ClickFix-style Cloudflare verification checks is part of a wider malware-as-a-service (MaaS) platform called Lunex .   The new findings come from Ontinue, which described the activity as a four-stage attack chain aimed at targeting Ukrainian-speaking users.   "The attack chain begins with a fake CAPTCHA page and culminates in the deployment of a fully-featured C2 agent," Ontinue threat researcher Rhys Downing said  in a technical report. "The stealer extracts credentials and data from seven Chromium-based browsers, exfiltrates cryptocurrency wallets, and establishes persistent remote filesystem access through a PowerShell-based Native Messaging Host installed within the victim's browser." articles.title_fr: Lunex Stealer abuse un pilote AMD pour désactiver la surveillance de sécurité et voler les identifiants de navigateur
articles.summary_fr: Le malware Psychedelic Stealer, distribué via des sites ukrainiens compromis, fait partie d'une plateforme de malware-as-a-service (MaaS) plus large nommée Lunex. Ontinue a identifié cette activité comme une chaîne d'attaque en quatre étapes ciblant les utilisateurs ukrainophones, débutant par une fausse page CAPTCHA et culminant avec le déploiement d'un agent C2. Le stealer est conçu pour extraire les identifiants de navigateurs, les portefeuilles de cryptomonnaies et établir un accès persistant au système de fichiers

articles.title: Attackers Bypass WAFs to Exploit Oracle PeopleSoft Flaw and Deploy Web Shells
articles.summary: Google is warning of renewed mass exploitation of a known security vulnerability in Oracle PeopleSoft as part of a campaign targeting multiple sectors globally.   The ShinyHunters-linked activity involves the weaponization of CVE-2026-35273  (CVSS score: 9.8), a critical security flaw that could result in unauthenticated remote code execution.   The vulnerability was first exploited  as a zero-day in attacks against academic institutions to conduct reconnaissance, deploy remote access software like MeshCentral agent for persistence, move laterally over SSH, run a shell script to connect via SSH to other internal PeopleSoft machines using known username/password combinations, and steal data.
